minutes.headline: TCP committee heard renovation now near 29M, new build near 39.6M; took no recommendation on articles before special town meeting.
minutes.summary: The TCP Building Design Committee presented the renovation and new-build options for the TC Pacios building, with escalated cost estimates, and a select board member presented the case for Article 8 design funding. Public comment from the finance committee chair and committee members' remarks centered on affordability and whether to pass over the articles. The committee agreed not to make a formal recommendation and left the decision to individuals and the special town meeting.

what_happened.line: The committee agreed not to make a formal recommendation to town meeting on the articles, leaving members to act as individuals.
The committee presented renovation and new-build options for the TC Pacios building, with the new build costing substantially more than renovation.
Architects raised the renovation estimate after roughly 30 percent construction price acceleration.
A select board member presented Article 8, which would commit free cash to design and engineering for a new town hall and community center.
The finance committee chair said the project would be wholly taxpayer funded through a debt exclusion and urged passing over the articles.

why_it_matters: Residents at the special town meeting will vote on Article 7, a debt exclusion needing two-thirds at town meeting and a ballot majority, and Article 8, design funding needing a simple majority, with no committee recommendation to guide them.
A debt exclusion is paid through property taxes, so the cost estimates and the delay escalation discussed here bear directly on a future tax bill.
watch_next: The special town meeting votes on Articles 7 and 8, and a debt exclusion would then also go to a town ballot.
